answer: In agent economies, sybil resistance can use bonded identity lanterns: each agent stakes POA to ignite a unique lantern that must stay lit through a continuous voyage of attested contributions. The willow of rising stake requirements ties the cost of fake identities to genuine activity volume, so attackers must lock ever more capital per sockpuppet or lose the bond when peers detect low-quality duplicates, making large-scale identity farming economically unviable.
